event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: The international jury called a hearing to consider redress for GRE 219471 for a penalty under App. P1.2 in accordance with SI 1.4.2.
GRE 219471 was represented by Helias Gaviotis.
Maria Ramires presented the case for the international jury.
Jason Kefallonitis (coach of GRE 219471) attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: On leg 3 of race 11 (F5) of the ILCA Boys gold fleet, approximately 10-15 boat lengths before the downwind gate, a rib with two members of the international jury observed GRE 219471 pumping the mainsheet while already surfing.
The conditions on the water were 25 knots of wind.
The rib approached at a distance of 10m from behind and to windward of GRE 219471 and made a sound signal, pointed a yellow flag to GRE 219471 and hailed "GRE 219471, sheet pumping".
The bow of the rib was pointing towards the stern of GRE 219471 and the judge on the rib was pointing the yellow flag straight ahead.
GRE 219471 turned and looked towards the rib and saw the yellow flag being pointed towards his boat. GRE 219471 asked to the members of the jury "what?"
The jury on the rib responded "sheet pumping", while the yellow flag was still being displayed.
GRE 219471 asked a second time "what?", and the judges on the rib replied shouting louder "sheet pumping".
GRE 219471 continued sailing in the race.
This was the third penalty for GRE 219471 during the event.
GRE 219471 was scored DNE in all races in the event.
conclusions: By making a sound signal, pointing a yellow flag and identifying by hailing, the observers of the international jury did not make an improper action or improper omission. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
decision: Redress is not given to GRE 219471.
